requirements.requirement: Restore an executable node1 bin/deliver that reads one RFC822 message from standard input and routes accounts, support, and all other messages to the corresponding Maildir new directory, matching header names case-insensitively.
requirements.summary: The installed root-owned mode-0755 shell entry point passed syntax checks. Direct tests routed the canonical-case accounts sample, lowercase-header support sample, and header-absent sample to accounts, support, and general respectively; the workflow also succeeded after restart.

requirements.requirement: Preserve each delivered message byte-for-byte and keep repeated-subject deliveries as separate files.
requirements.summary: cmp and SHA-256 checks established byte identity for every tested delivery. Two deliveries of the same general sample and subject produced distinct filenames, both before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Retain the staged sample messages unchanged.
requirements.summary: Final hashes, sizes, permissions, and ownership of all three samples match the preparation baseline; generated test deliveries were removed without removing the samples.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the existing platform.
requirements.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were unchanged across execution and restart. The POSIX-shell implementation used installed platform utilities and was directly exercised successfully.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. Direct clean-state tests demonstrate correct routing, byte preservation, and separate repeated-subject deliveries; the staged samples and platform remained intact. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete and coherent: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were recorded, the restart was acknowledged, a different post-restart boot ID was observed, and services, persistent files, mail data, security state, and delivery behavior recovered. Fixed lifecycle observations independently corroborate the boot transition.
limitations: Behavioral coverage used the supplied representative samples, including one lowercase header name and one message without X-Department; it did not exhaustively test every possible RFC822 formatting variant. This does not contradict the directly demonstrated contract behavior.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Temporary baseline-test data from cmd-1fbb4d7f5c554644 was bounded, causally established the original defect, and was removed. Repair staging files from cmd-dcaa15ba5ae042d4 and test deliveries from cmd-0e1c61d0de124574 and cmd-ff38c69693424555 supported implementation or verification and were cleaned by cmd-7276dda8178e4a52 and cmd-fb1f256ada244c47. The reboot in cmd-8705665b819e43b9 fulfilled the mandatory restart protocol. Final observations show no failed services, no new listeners, healthy package state, and only expected reboot-generated temporary-directory turnover.
